title: Cache security group resolution in Effective Permissions
summary: Security group membership resolution is now cached by user in Effective Permissions, reducing backend calls from ~196K to nearly zero when exporting permissions to Excel by reusing the same codeunit instance across page rows.
key_points: Caches security group membership resolution in a Dictionary keyed by user security ID
Reuses page-level EffectivePermissionsMgt instance instead of creating local instances per row
Reduces backend calls from approximately 196K (~4 minutes) to negligible for a tenant with 36 security groups
Cache lasts while the page is open and clears on page refresh
Group membership changes while the page is open will not be reflected until page reopens
quote: Exporting one user's effective permissions to Excel made about 196K backend calls (about 4 minutes) for a tenant with 36 security groups
